issues.description: The problem statement requests the names and types of all swimming pools and the name and all population counts of the related municipalities, but the solution query selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name. This contradicts the specification and may confuse students using the solution as a reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to select the swimming pool name instead of its id. For example, change Schwimmbad.id to Schwimmbad.name in solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql so the SELECT list matches the problem statement (SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w ...). Alternatively, if the id was intentional, adjust the problem statement to request the id instead of the name.

issues.description: The problem statement asks for the names of all Schwimmbäder, but the solution query selects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name. This is a naming/content mismatch between the problem requirement and the solution implementation and can confuse students about which column represents the 'name' of a Schwimmbad.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution query to select the Schwimmbad name column (Schwimmbad.name) instead of Schwimmbad.id so it matches the problem statement. For example: SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art as Art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel
